title: 定语的位置
goal: 能识别中心名词并排列英文定语。

points.label: 找出连续定语修饰的中心名词
按英文结构排列短语定语

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文的多个定语通常都放在中心名词之前。译成英文时，先找出中心名词，再按定语的形式安排位置。单个形容词放在中心名词前，介词短语和分词短语放在中心名词后。

body.box:
原文：村里保存的古老地图记录了河道的变化。
译文：The old maps preserved in the village record changes in the river channel.

cards.title: 前置定语
rows: 这座小型博物馆展示古老的木制工具。
The small museum displays old wooden tools.
tools 由 old 和 wooden 修饰。
当地居民保存了珍贵的历史照片。
Local residents preserved valuable historical photographs.
photographs 是宾语中心词。
这座石桥连接两个安静的村庄。
The stone bridge connects two quiet villages.
bridge 是主语中心词。
这个大型图书馆收藏许多地方文献。
The large library holds many local documents.
documents 由 local 修饰。

cards.title: 后置定语
rows: 博物馆收藏了来自山村的木制面具。
The museum holds wooden masks from mountain villages.
from mountain villages 修饰 masks。
学生阅读了关于当地历史的英文书籍。
Students read English books about local history.
about local history 修饰 books。
图书馆展示了村民捐赠的珍贵手稿。
The library displays valuable manuscripts donated by villagers.
donated by villagers 修饰 manuscripts。
通向山顶的狭窄小路经过一片树林。
The narrow path leading to the summit passes through a wood.
leading to the summit 修饰 path。

cards.title: 定语的层次
rows: 村庄保存的古老木制面具被送到博物馆。
The old wooden masks preserved in the village were sent to the museum.
old 和 wooden 在前，preserved in the village 在后，都修饰 masks。
书架上有关传统建筑的英文书籍属于学校。
The English books about traditional architecture on the shelf belong to the school.
两个介词短语修饰 books。
学生修复了画家使用过的旧木桌。
Students restored the old wooden table used by the painter.
used by the painter 修饰 table。
画家使用了学生修复过的旧木桌。
The painter used the old wooden table restored by students.
restored by students 修饰 table。

items.stem: 原文：博物馆展示了村民捐赠的古老木椅。选择译句。
options: The museum displays old wooden chairs donated by villagers.
The museum displays wooden chairs donated by old villagers.
The museum displays old villagers who donated wooden chairs.
The museum donates old wooden chairs displayed by villagers.
items.why: 古老、木制和村民捐赠的都修饰椅子，中心名词是 chairs。第一项把 old wooden 放在前面，donated by villagers 放在后面。第二项把古老错放到了 villagers 上。

items.stem: 原文：这家商店出售当地制作的传统纸灯。选择译句。
options: The shop sells local makers of traditional paper lanterns.
The shop sells traditional paper lanterns made locally.
The local shop sells traditional lanterns made of paper.
The shop makes traditional paper lanterns sold locally.
items.why: 出售的是纸灯，中心名词是 lanterns。第二项把当地制作译成 made locally，放在 lanterns 后面。第三项把当地错放到了 shop 上。

items.stem: 原文：通往湖边的狭窄道路经过一片农田。排列译句。
items.why: leading to the lake 紧接中心名词 road。

items.stem: 原文：博物馆收藏了关于古代航海的英文书籍。排列译句。
items.why: about ancient navigation 是修饰 books 的后置介词短语。

items.stem: 原文：工匠修复了村里居民使用过的旧船。选择译句。
options: The villagers restored the old boat used by craftspeople.
The craftspeople restored the boat used by old villagers.
The craftspeople restored the old boat used by villagers.
The craftspeople used the old boat restored by villagers.
items.why: 修复的是旧船，中心名词是 boat。第三项把 old 放在 boat 前，used by villagers 放在 boat 后。

items.stem: 原文：图书馆展示了当地画家创作的水彩画。排列译句。
items.why: created by local artists 后置，修饰 watercolors。

items.stem: 原文：学生研究了关于古代农业的中文文献。选择译句。
options: Students studied ancient Chinese documents about agriculture.
Students studied documents about ancient Chinese agriculture.
Chinese students studied documents about ancient agriculture.
Students studied Chinese documents about ancient agriculture.
items.why: 古代修饰农业，中文修饰文献。第四项用 Chinese documents 和 about ancient agriculture 保留了这两层关系。第一项把古代错放到了文献上。

items.stem: 原文：博物馆保存了工匠制作的古老陶罐。选择译句。
options: The museum preserves old clay jars made by craftspeople.
The museum preserves clay jars made by old craftspeople.
The craftspeople preserve old clay jars made by the museum.
The museum makes old clay jars preserved by craftspeople.
items.why: 保存的是陶罐，中心名词是 jars。第一项把 old clay 放在前面，made by craftspeople 放在后面。第二项把古老错放到了工匠上。

items.stem: 原文：研究人员收集了河边种植的药用植物。选择译句。
options: Researchers grew medicinal plants collected by the river.
Researchers collected medicinal plants grown by the river.
Researchers collected medicinal plants and grew them by the river.
Researchers by the river collected medicinal plants.
items.why: 河边种植的修饰药用植物。第二项把 grown by the river 放在 plants 后面。第四项把河边错放到了研究人员上。

items.stem: 原文：村民翻修了通往市场的旧石桥。选择译句。
options: Villagers restored the market leading to the old stone bridge.
Villagers restored the old market leading to a stone bridge.
Villagers restored the old stone bridge leading to the market.
Villagers restored the old stone bridge leading from the market.
items.why: 翻修的是旧石桥，中心名词是 bridge，通往市场修饰桥。第三项把 leading to the market 放在 bridge 后面。第四项把通往改成了从市场出发。

items.stem: 原文：附近工匠制作的木制桌子被送到学校。排列译句。
items.why: made by nearby craftspeople 修饰 tables，were sent 是谓语。

items.stem: 原文：图书馆保存的古老地图展示了当地河流。排列译句。
items.why: maps 是中心名词，preserved in the library 修饰地图。

items.stem: 原文：博物馆展示了来自沿海村庄的传统渔船。排列译句。
items.why: from coastal villages 放在 boats 后，说明渔船的来源。

items.stem: 原文：研究人员检查了建在山坡上的石墙。排列译句。
items.why: built on the hillside 放在 wall 后，说明石墙的位置。
